starting_status: clean implementation worktree; fetched remote identical; no intervening commits

physics.q: defining equilibrium roots; original sigma_epsilon, kappa^2*q=sigma_epsilon*Delta
physics.K: q*utau^2; endpoint and constant outer, transported nonconstant inner
physics.pressure: Pi_inner=0, Pi_outer=-Qzz; absolute outlet total traction, no gauge
physics.evolution: unchanged one-sweep PIMPLE; GeneratedVolumeOwnerV1; eta=0; corrections Off; no forcing

mean_fit.coordinate: physical flat z above numerical wall, no displacement shift
mean_fit.roughness: separate effective sand-grain h_s(model,H); original intercept correlation; 0<=h_s<H
mean_fit.normalization: unchanged piecewise linear physical-height interpolation at 40 mm, same observed points shared with fit; never reset fitted U(Hh) to one
mean_fit.uncertainty: joint velocity/coordinate extraction envelopes for points 0..5; fixed fit memberships; all 4096 joint box vertices plus deterministic shared-axis and interior checks; normalize and reselect bracketing observations per scenario. Numerical envelopes, not confidence intervals or exhaustive experimental uncertainty.

observation_audit: all turbulence physical heights and lower coordinate envelopes; closest-normal transform of hill profile (vertical!=normal); Fig11 physical distance unavailable; unreported probe/experimental uncertainty separate

native.boundary: AcceptedOpenFlatV1 + NeutralCompositeV1; compatible top, full total traction outlet, zero streamwise scalar diffusion, original RejectV1

domain.interpretation: 80mm compatible truncation of strict logarithm, not a free-stream cap or actual tunnel roof

native.mesh: inner sorted union {0,H/32,H/16,H/8,H/4,H/2,H,h_s,cutoff,positive viscosity intercept}; outer {H,.25,.5,1,2}. Every case frozen after central fit; no adapting evolved mesh. All active profile breaks retained by split quadrature.
native.degree_control: A95 6mm same partition P4/P2, both dt; no other mesh search
native.order: A95 6mm, A93 6mm, E94E95 6mm, then height sensitivities; independent stopping
native.projection: continuous provider directly projected; supplied Functions and initialization use same evaluator; no Hermite surrogate

limits.scales: U(Hh)=1, k=K, outer epsilon=utau^3/(kappa*H), Pi=U(Hh)^2, traction=utau^2
limits.integration_vs_projection: separate; polynomial residual is unanchored and reported, never subtracted
limits.spatial_interpretation: compare equal-time physical weighted RMS and local margins; unresolved unless global field differences<=1e-3 and timestep difference<=max(1e-7,.1*spatial difference); no convergence-order claim

stopping: first production-required domain, physical accuracy or complete primitive gate failure stops that case; diagnostic predictor alone does not add rejection. A .02 continuation needs both dt at .008 and their own complete gates; rough sensitivities independent.

resources.history: CT1-CT3 receipts including resource failures unchanged
